_comment: Example rules. Copy to rules.json and edit: cp job_scraper/config/rules.example.json job_scraper/config/rules.json — see the README for what every key does.
_contact_comment: Who is fetching, advertised in the User-Agent on every request. Fill both in: a career site owner who wonders what is reading their pages should be able to find out in one click or one email. They live here rather than in the code because rules.json is gitignored, so your address stays out of the public repo. Left empty, every run warns and identifies itself as 'job-scraper/0.1 (no contact configured)'.
_non_place_locations_comment: Terms that name no specific place. A location field made only of these ("Home base - EMEA", a bare country, "2 Locations") is not judged against `locations` at all: it passes Layer 1 provisionally and Layer 5 settles it against the job description, dropping it if no listed location is named there. Matched whole-word and casefolded; extend it from your own drop log.
_remote_regions_comment: Regions that include where you live, as your sources write them. A remote or home-based role across one of these ("Home based - <region>", "Remote | <region>") is admitted as remote, even when the field also offers an office city. A region alone, with no remote or home-based wording anywhere in the job, is still deferred like a bare country. Home-based with no region, and worldwide, are admitted without this key. Leave it empty and every regional field is deferred to Layer 5. The value below is invented: replace it.
